sourceRecords.title: Google Ngram Viewer — What does the Ngram Viewer do?
sourceRecords.applicableClaim: Viewer percentages use the total population of the same n-gram order in the selected corpus and year: a unigram is relative to all unigrams, a bigram to all bigrams, and a trigram to all trigrams.
sourceRecords.repositoryUse: Determine the denominator label from the exact token count of each registered query; never place different n-gram orders on a shared generic per-million scale.
sourceRecords.sourceLocation: What does the Ngram Viewer do?, paragraphs 2–3
